title: About Cadence
intro: Cadence is a calm personal habit tracker. Build daily and weekly habits, keep your streaks, and see your progress over time.
how: Tick a habit off each day. A streak counts the days (or weeks) in a row you kept it, and a missed day breaks it, so the day's list always shows what is still open.

daily.title: Daily and weekly habits
daily.text: Do it every day, or a set number of days each week. Each habit follows its own rhythm.

streaks.title: Streaks that stay fair
streaks.text: A streak counts the days, or the weeks, in a row you kept a habit. Miss one and it starts over, no hiding it.

home.title: A home for your day
home.text: Home shows what is left today, a greeting, and a nudge that gets louder as the day runs out.

progress.title: Progress at a glance
progress.text: A year heatmap, weekly bars and completion rates show how the last weeks really went.

private.title: Private by default
private.text: You sign in with Google and only you can see your habits.

theme.title: Light and dark
theme.text: A warm paper-like light theme and a coffee-dark one. The moon icon in the top bar switches between them.
